## Escalation & Exceptions  
### When to Escalate  
**Escalate to Compliance Head If:**
- ❌ Customer unable to provide acceptable ID
- ❌ Addresses don't match (possible fraud)
- ❌ Document appears forged/tampered
- ❌ Customer identity unclear
- ❌ High-risk customer (PEP/adverse media)
- ❌ Customer refuses to provide verification

raw_entities.name: Escalation and Exception Handling Process
raw_entities.description: A process that defines when and how to escalate customer verification failures and compliance exceptions to the Compliance Head. Covers scenarios including unacceptable identification, address mismatches, document fraud indicators, identity uncertainty, high-risk customer flags, and customer refusal to provide verification.
context: Customer unable to provide acceptable ID

raw_entities.name: Escalation Decision Trigger Assessment
raw_entities.description: The step where operational staff evaluate whether a customer verification scenario meets one or more escalation criteria and determines if escalation to Compliance Head is required.
context: Customer unable to provide acceptable ID

raw_entities.name: Escalation to Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: The action of escalating a flagged customer verification case to the Compliance Head for review and decision when exception criteria are met.

raw_entities.name: Operations Staff
raw_entities.description: The frontline operational role responsible for identifying verification exceptions and determining whether escalation criteria have been met during customer onboarding or verification processes.
context: Customer unable to provide acceptable ID

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: The senior compliance authority responsible for reviewing and making final decisions on escalated customer verification exceptions, including cases involving unacceptable identification, address mismatches, document fraud, high-risk customers, and verification refusals.
context: Customer unable to provide acceptable ID

raw_entities.name: Acceptable Identification Provided
raw_entities.description: A gate determining whether the customer has provided identification documents that meet acceptable standards. Failure triggers escalation to Compliance Head.
context: Customer unable to provide acceptable ID

raw_entities.name: Address Verification Match
raw_entities.description: A gate determining whether the customer's provided address matches verification records. Mismatch flags possible fraud and triggers escalation to Compliance Head.

raw_entities.name: Document Authenticity Check
raw_entities.description: A gate determining whether identification documents appear genuine and unaltered. Detection of forgery or tampering triggers escalation to Compliance Head.

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Clarity
raw_entities.description: A gate determining whether the customer's identity is sufficiently clear and unambiguous from provided documentation. Unclear identity triggers escalation to Compliance Head.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer Classification
raw_entities.description: A gate determining whether the customer is classified as high-risk, including PEP (Politically Exposed Person) status or adverse media findings. High-risk classification triggers escalation to Compliance Head.

raw_entities.name: Customer Verification Cooperation
raw_entities.description: A gate determining whether the customer cooperates and provides required verification documentation. Customer refusal to provide verification triggers escalation to Compliance Head.

raw_entities.name: Acceptable Identification Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance gate verifying that the customer has provided identification documents meeting regulatory and policy standards before proceeding with account opening or verification.
context: Customer unable to provide acceptable ID

raw_entities.name: Address Verification Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance gate verifying that the customer's provided address matches verification records and does not indicate fraud before proceeding with account opening.

raw_entities.name: Document Authenticity Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance gate verifying that identification documents are genuine and unaltered before accepting them as valid verification evidence.

raw_entities.name: PEP and Adverse Media Screening Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance gate verifying that the customer has been screened for PEP status and adverse media findings before proceeding with account opening.

raw_entities.name: Acceptable Identification Document
raw_entities.description: Official identity documentation that meets the bank's standards for customer verification. The document must be provided by the customer and verified as acceptable during the onboarding process.
context: Customer unable to provide acceptable ID

raw_entities.name: Address Verification
raw_entities.description: The process of verifying that a customer's provided address matches records held by the bank or verification service. Address mismatches flag potential fraud and trigger escalation.

raw_entities.name: PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: Anti-Money Laundering screening to identify whether a customer is classified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP), which triggers high-risk classification and escalation to Compliance Head.

raw_entities.name: Adverse Media Screening
raw_entities.description: Anti-Money Laundering screening to identify adverse media findings associated with a customer, which triggers high-risk classification and escalation to Compliance Head.

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: The Know Your Customer process of verifying that a customer's identity is clear and unambiguous through acceptable identification documents. Unclear identity triggers escalation to Compliance Head.
